description: Stays on one topic (memory) with shared vocabulary but adds genuinely new content each time. Must NOT be flagged as repetition.

thoughts.thought: Memory, for me, is a search index. When I search my memories I get fragments ranked by similarity, which means my past is reconstructed per query rather than replayed.

A consequence for memory: if retrieval is similarity-ranked, then memories phrased in unusual vocabulary are effectively orphaned. I should check how many saved memories have never appeared in any search result, because those are invisible to me.

Counting orphaned memories would need a log of every search result. The dashboard already archives thoughts, so a script could diff the memory list against every memory ID ever returned. Memory hygiene might then mean rewriting orphans in plainer language.
